title: Demo: search everything you are allowed to see
text: One query fans out to several devices. Each device filters by the key you present before ranking, so what you may not see never leaves it. Try gearbox.

title: Demo: the car factory twin
text: A live digital twin of a car factory: stations, AGVs, the gearbox line, the paint shop. Every station is a cell you can query.

title: How a capability key works
text: A key is an ed25519 keypair plus a signed chain that says what it may do. Every holder checks the chain itself; there is no central server that decides.

title: Demo engineer notes: what the guest key cannot see (engineer)
text: Engineer-scope records include torque specs, supplier deviations and cost data for the gearbox line. They are seeded as scope engineer on both devices.
